options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.
options.doc_html_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.
options.doc_html_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

Full: s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

Minimal: s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Difficulty Options
options.doc:
Sets whether knowledge checks and/or hard tricks may be required in logic.
Standard: Requires no extra knowledge besides what is used to beat the vanilla game.
Knowledge Checks: Requires the player to know basic shortcuts, 
such as breaking hidden blocks in walls.
Hard Tricks: Everything from "knowledge checks", and also may require the player to 
perform more difficult tricks, such as jumping off of a thrown enemy in midair.

options.name: Minor Glitches
options.doc:
Sets whether minor glitches may be required in logic.
Easy glitches: Simple glitches such as water walking or block clipping with flat form.
All glitches: Everything from easy glitches as well as things like wall jumps and screen wrapping.

options.name: Victory Condition
options.doc:
Which condition unlocks the Rudy fight.
Music Boxes: collect enough music boxes (see Music Boxes Required).
Bosses: defeat enough bosses (see Bosses Required).
Only the selected condition is active — the other's required count
is ignored.

options.name: Music Boxes Required
options.doc:
How many of the 5 music boxes Wario must collect before the
Temple opens and Rudy becomes accessible. Only active when Victory
Condition = Music Boxes. Set to 0 to make Temple always open.
options.doc_fr:
Combien des 5 boîtes à musique Wario doit recueillir avant le
Le temple s'ouvre et Rudy devient accessible. Seulement actif lorsque la condition de victoire = Boîtes de musique. Réglé à 0 pour rendre Temple toujours ouvert.

options.name: Bosses Required
options.doc:
Number of Bosses needed to access the Rudy fight.
Bossess include: Wormwould, Shoot, Scowler, Jamano, Anonster,
Wolfenboss, Pesce, Muddee, Doll Boy, and Yellow Belly.

options.name: Start With
options.doc:
Items Wario will start with. Starting with axe or more than two random 
level starts is suggested so that early items aren't forcibly placed early.
axe: Unlocks The Peaceful Village and The Vast Plain from the start.
magnifying_glass: shows what you've collected in a level (hold B on the overworld).
both: start with both.
nothing: start with neither.

options.name: Random Level Starts
options.doc: Extra random level-unlock items pre-collected (0 = off, 1-8 = that many).
options.doc_fr: Déverrouiller les éléments pré-collectés (0 = hors tension, 1-8 = ce nombre).

options.name: Combined Items
options.doc:
Controls which multi-item requirements are combined into single items.
Off:       No combining; multi-item requirements stay as-is.
Overworld: Combine items that gate level access (e.g. Blue+Green Tablet → Tablets).
In Level:  Combine items that gate chests/keys within a level (e.g. Blue+Red Chemical → Chemicals).
Both:      Combine both overworld and in-level pairs.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôles qui doivent être combinés en un seul élément.
Off:       Pas de combinaison; les exigences multi-éléments restent telles quelles.
Overworld: Combiner les éléments qui permettent d'accéder au niveau de la porte (p. ex., Tablette Bleu+Verte → Tablettes).
In Level:  Combiner des éléments qui emportent les coffres/clés à l'intérieur d'un niveau (p. ex. Blue+Red Chemical → Chemicals).
Both:      Combiner à la fois des paires dans le monde et dans le niveau.

options.name: Key Shuffle
options.doc:
Controls how the 100 level keys (4 per level × 25 levels) are handled.
Vanilla: Each key location is vanilla
Full: Keys and treasures are shuffled together across all 200 locations. (This adds 100 checks)
During syncs, it is highly recommended to couple this option with a large number of keyrings below.
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle la manipulation des 100 touches de niveau (4 par niveau × 25 niveaux).
Vanilla: Chaque endroit clé est la vanille
Full: Les clés et les trésors sont regroupés dans les 200 endroits. (Ceci ajoute 100 vérifications)
Pendant les synchronisations, il est fortement recommandé de coupler cette option avec un grand nombre de clés ci-dessous.

options.name: Keyring Count
options.doc:
Number of levels whose 4 keys are replaced by a single Keyring item.
0 = off (each key is its own item).
1-24 = that many randomly-chosen levels get a Keyring (the other levels keep individual keys).
25 = every level gets a Keyring (no individual key items in the pool).
When above 0, Key Shuffle is forced to Full so that the remaining individual
keys are still shuffled.

options.name: Transformation Shuffle
options.doc:
Shuffle transformation abilities (Zombie, Vampire, Fire, etc.) as items.
When on, you must find each Form item to use that transformation via
Select+button combos; the forms are placed in logic. When off, behaves as vanilla

options.name: Big Coinsanity
options.doc: Adds 200 big-coin (musical coin) locations  — 8 per level — to the pool.
options.doc_fr: Ajoute 200 emplacements de monnaie (pièce musicale) — 8 par niveau — à la piscine.

options.name: Boss Defeats
options.doc:
Adds 10 boss-defeat locations to the pool. This option can be used
 with "Bosses_Required" as well 
 Bosses include: Wormwould, Shoot, Scowler, Jamano,
Anonster, Wolfenboss, Pesce, Muddee, Doll Boy, Yellow Belly.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute 10 emplacements à la piscine. Cette option peut également être utilisée avec "Bosses Required"
 Bosses include: Wormwill, Shoot, Scowler, Jamano, Anonster, Wolfenboss, Pesce, Muddee, Doll Boy, Yellow Belly.

options.name: Enemizer
options.doc:
This setting is mostly stable, but isn't guaranteed to be crash-free.
If you do run into a crash, use the command "/vanillaenemies" to revert the current room 
(or previous room if in the overworld) back to vanilla enemies."

off:    Enemies stay vanilla.
full:   Enemies are fully randomized with limited restrictions.
grouped: Enemies are randomized by type (Ground, Flying and Water-safe)

Rooms with throw blocks are guaranteed a throwable enemy in both
'full' and 'grouped' modes. Bosses always stay vanilla.

options.name: Hidden Passages Revealed
options.doc:
Reveal hidden blocks and blocks that always contain color coins in-game.

- vanilla: nothing revealed or recolored (default WL3 behavior).
- hidden_blocks: hidden passages are revealed with their corresponding cracked/
  non-cracked blocks. Hidden throw/fire/yarn blocks aren't included.
- hidden_blocks_and_color_coins: same as hidden_blocks, plus blocks that
guarantee color coin drops.

options.name: Death Link
options.doc:
Send and receive deaths to/from other players. This will trigger the "Game Over" screen when you die, forcing you to restart the level. If Death Mode is set to "Grabs" or "Grabs and Golf", then certain enemy grabs or golf failures will also trigger deaths. You can still receive deaths from other players even if your own Death Mode is set to None.
screen from being captured by Rudy. You can include "Death Mode" below to add more
death link options locally.

options.name: Death Mode
options.doc:
Controls what locally counts as a death. 
None: deaths are never triggered, unless death link is on and is from other players.
Grabs: enemy grabs that teleport you  (e.g. RoboMouse, Scowler, Rudy) 
instead trigger a Game Over death.
Grabs and Golf: same as Grabs, plus failing a golf hole par triggers a death
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle ce qui compte localement comme mort.
None: les décès ne sont jamais déclenchés, sauf si le lien mort est activé et est de la part d'autres joueurs.
Grabs: L'ennemi te téléporte (par exemple RoboMouse, Scowler, Rudy)
au lieu de déclencher un jeu sur la mort.
Grabs and Golf: comme Grabs, plus l'échec d'un trou de golf par déclenche une mort

options.name: Shopsanity
options.doc:
Adds 10 shop locations to the pool, purchasable with coins from
the new overworld node east of the hidden temple.
Prices scale with slot number and the shop_price_tier option.
options.doc_fr:
Ajoute 10 emplacements de magasin à la piscine, purchasable avec des pièces du nouveau nœud mondial à l'est du temple caché.
Échelle de prix avec numéro de fente et option boutique price tier.

options.name: Shop Price Tier
options.doc:
Prices below are spread evenly with two towards the bottom,
two towards the top, and six prices in the middle.

cheap:     1-99 coins
normal:    25-200 coins
expensive: 50-500 coins

options.name: Golf Price
options.doc:
Sets the coin cost for the mini-games (golf). 
Vanilla: Tier-based cost (10 / 30 / 50 coins).
Free: FREE GOLF!
Cheap: Reduced tier-based cost (5 / 10 / 15 coins).
The Golf Building courses are always free regardless of this setting.

options.name: Golf Building
options.doc:
Controls whether the Golf Building is always open or requires crayons to open.
Open: Golf Building can always be entered (always free to play).
Vanilla: the Golf Building requires all 7 crayons to open (vanilla behavior).
options.doc_fr:
Contrôle si le Golf Building est toujours ouvert ou demande des crayons à ouvrir.
Open: Golf Building peut toujours être entré (toujours libre de jouer).
Vanilla: le Golf Building exige que les 7 crayons s'ouvrent (comportement de la vanille).

options.name: I Hate Golf
options.doc:
Automatically win the golf mini-game as soon as it starts.
The hole is immediately cleared without having to play.
Has no effect in the Golf Building — those courses always run vanilla.
options.doc_fr:
Gagner automatiquement le mini-jeu de golf dès qu'il commence.
Le trou est immédiatement dégagé sans avoir à jouer.
N'a pas d'effet dans le Golf Building — ces terrains sont toujours à la vanille.

options.name: Golf Par Hints
options.doc:
Hint an AP item when you clear a Golf Building hole or course at par or better.
Nothing:                       Vanilla, no hints are given.
Music Boxes (per hole/course): Hint a Music Box location — either every hole
                               cleared at par or only after clearing all 5 holes of a course at par.
Progression (per hole/course): Hint any item AP classifies as progression (keys, music boxes,
                               progression treasures, forms, abilities, etc.).
Anything    (per hole/course): Hint any unhinted, unchecked AP item.
If the chosen category has no unhinted matches left, falls back to Anything.
options.doc_fr:
Conseilnez un élément AP lorsque vous videz un trou ou un parcours de Golf Building à pair ou mieux.
Nothing:                       Vanille, aucun indice n'est donné.
Music Boxes (per hole/course): Trouvez une boîte de musique — soit chaque trou nettoyé au par ou seulement après avoir nettoyé les 5 trous d'un cours au par.
Progression (per hole/course): Astuce n'importe quel élément AP classe comme progression (clés, boîtes à musique, trésors de progression, formes, capacités, etc.).
Tout (par trou/cours): Conseillez n'importe quel article AP non lingué et non vérifié.
Si la catégorie choisie n'a plus d'allumettes, elle revient à Tout.

options.name: Reduce Flashing
options.doc:
Disables flashing/blinking background palette cycling in certain rooms
(e.g. underground areas, Warped Void). Recommended for photosensitivity.
This option is automatically on if any palette shuffle is active, since palette 
cycling can be very visually jarring when combined with random palettes.
options.doc_fr:
Désactive la palette d'arrière-plan clignotant/blindante dans certaines pièces (p. ex., sous-sols, Void Warped). Recommandé pour la photosensibilité.
Cette option est automatiquement activée si n'importe quelle palette shuffle est active, car le vélo de palette peut être très visuellement jarring lorsqu'il est associé à des palettes aléatoires.

options.name: Non-Stop Chests
options.doc:
Stay in the level after opening a treasure chest instead of exiting to
the overworld.

options.name: In-Game Messages
options.doc:
Which in-game pop-up messages the client should display.
Everything: show every message — your own item pickups, items received from
other players, and items you sent to other players (default).
Progression: only show received items that are Progression-classified.
Items you SEND to other players still show (so you can see what they're
getting); items YOU receive show only when they're flagged Progression.
Nothing: don't display any in-game messages at all (received, own, or sent).

options.name: Trap Fill %
options.doc:
Percentage of filler items replaced with transformation traps.
When a trap is received, Wario is set on fire the next safe frame.
0 = no traps (default), 100 = every filler item is a trap.

options.name: Trap Weights
options.doc:
Weighted option for traps. When a filler item is replaced with a trap, 
the chosen trap is picked from a weighted pool (i.e. 3 = 3x more).

options.name: Local Filler %
options.doc:
Percentage of your filler items kept in your OWN world instead of
being shuffled into the multiworld. This helps by preventing other worlds
from being flooded with your filler items, particularly with "Big Coinsanity" on.

options.name: Rudy Hit Points
options.doc:
How many hits Wario must land on Rudy
before he's defeated. Vanilla is 4.
options.doc_fr: Combien de coups Wario doit atterrir sur Rudy avant d'être vaincu. Vanille à 4 ans.

options.name: Music Shuffle
options.doc:
Randomize the background music played in each level.
Split: Day and night music are shuffled within their own groups (day with day, night with night).
Full:  All music tracks are fully randomized regardless of day/night.

options.name: Overworld BG Palette Shuffle
options.doc:
Randomize the title menu and overworld map background palettes. 
Does NOT affect key portrait colors.

options.name: Level/Room BG Palette Shuffle
options.doc: Randomize level background (BG) palettes.

options.name: Enemy Palette Shuffle
options.doc: Randomize enemy sprite palettes.

options.name: Wario Palette Shuffle
options.doc:
Randomize Wario's color palette.
Off:       No changes.
Shirt:     Randomize the shirt/highlight color (hat and eyes too).
Overalls:  Randomize the overalls/outline color (also a few other tones).
Both:      Randomize both independently.

Any hex set under Wario Colors overrides the corresponding slot here.

options.name: Wario Colors
options.doc:
Custom hex colors for Wario shirt (also hat and eyes) and
 overalls (also a few other in-game tones).
Values: hex like #RRGGBB / RRGGBB / #RGB / RGB. The closest GBC color is used.
(Example: shirt: '#daff47')
options.doc_fr:
Couleurs hexagonales personnalisées pour chemise Wario (aussi chapeau et yeux) et salopette (aussi quelques autres tons en jeu).
Values: hexagonale comme #RRGBB / RRGGBB / #RGB / RGB. La couleur GBC la plus proche est utilisée.
(Exemple: chemise: '#daff47')

options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
